intro.title: Rooftop Restaurant & Cocktail Menu in Oceanside
text: Perched above The Brick Hotel in Downtown Oceanside, Cococabana brings Caribbean-inspired food and craft cocktails to an open-air rooftop setting. The menu is designed for lingering: shareable plates, satisfying mains, and bright flavors that feel at home near the Pacific.

Join us for rooftop dining throughout the week, settle in with a cocktail, or make a weekend of it with Saturday and Sunday brunch. Explore the kitchen and bar menus below, then reserve your table when you are ready to head upstairs.
